subject: Request: temporary night response variance + escalation playbook
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary night response variance + escalation playbook

Hi Liam --

Following our call this morning: thank you for outlining the midnight->06:00 UTC growth window that will overlap with AtlasBank's migration. To keep the service healthy while we scale capacity I want to propose a short-term, scoped variance to our support response commitments for the affected nights.

Proposal (3-week window starting 2025-06-09):
- P1 (service unavailable or severe degradation): 10 minute acknowledgement, 30 minute remediation target for initial mitigation (we'll still escalate to on-call pager immediately).
- P2 (major degradation impacting throughput/latency but not total outage): 90 minute acknowledgement, 6 hour remediation target.
- Dedicated on-call shadowing: Redwood will assign a shadow engineer each night 00:00–06:00 UTC to work directly with Atlas ops for the migration weekend.
- Escalation playbook: Redwood will provide a one-page ladder (on-call -> engineering lead -> SRE manager -> CSM on-call) and a single conference bridge for high-severity events.

We know credits and formal amendments go through procurement; this request is operational: we want to confirm you are comfortable with the above as a temporary operational carveout so we can stand up the shadow rota and escalation ladder. If you agree I will: attach a mutual action plan, add the on-call contacts, and propose a DocuSign amendment for the limited window.

Next steps: please confirm by EOD Mon 2025-06-09 whether Atlas agrees with the operational parameters.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (stub)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary night response variance + escalation playbook

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the clear proposal — this matches the operational constraints we discussed. A couple of asks from our side before we sign off:

1) Mutual action plan with explicit weekday-by-week activities and an itemized rollback trigger (we need to be able to revert if latency trends exceed threshold X).
2) A credit rubric for potential missed targets during the window (we'll route this through procurement but want to quantify).
3) The escalation ladder and phone numbers for the pager contacts (we need at least two reachable escalation contacts per level).

Can you add the rollback trigger and the first-pass credit rubric to the MAP? Also confirm whether the shadowing engineers will have direct access to our incident bridge or whether Redwood will join Atlas's bridge.

If we can include those items, I can get verbal approval from Platform Ops and loop in Procurement to draft an amendment.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Platform Operations Lead
AtlasBank
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary night response variance + escalation playbook

Thanks Liam — appreciate the quick review. I've updated the MAP (attached) with: rollback triggers, a simple credit rubric, and the proposed escalation ladder including two backup contacts per level. Highlights:

- Rollback trigger: 10% sustained p95 latency increase over a sliding 20-minute window OR error rate > 2.5% for 10 minutes. If triggered, Redwood will initiate rollback and notify Atlas within 5 minutes; both teams execute rollback checklist.
- Credit rubric (summary): missed acknowledgement window = 0.25% service credit per missed P1 acknowledgement; missed remediation SLA = 0.5% credit; cumulative cap for the variance window = 5% of monthly invoice. (Procurement/legal may want different language; this is a starting point.)
- Escalation ladder (contact order): on-call engineer (pager) -> on-call lead (email+pager) -> SRE manager (phone) -> CSM / account director. All contacts listed with mobile numbers in escalation_contacts_v1.csv.

Shadowing access: Redwood shadow engineer will join Atlas's incident bridge during high-severity events. We will request temporary bridge access and adhere to your access controls — no persistent credentials.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (updated stub), escalation_contacts_v1.csv (stub).

Can we lock the MAP and have Procurement start a brief amendment that mirrors the credit rubric? If Atlas confirms verbal approval today, we will provision the shadow rota for 2025-06-09 night and run a dry-run on 2025-06-08 23:30 UTC.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasbank.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary night response variance + escalation playbook

Liam — thanks for the signal. Atlas's verbal OK today is sufficient for Redwood to proceed with operational changes and the dry-run tomorrow. Procurement can follow with the formal amendment; we'll mirror the credit rubric in the DocuSign and expect Procurement to confirm or redline.

I'll open a JIRA to track deliverables and runbook items: JIRA-INC-4827. Actions I'm assigning now:
- Ben: finalize MAP and upload to shared Drive (done).
- Rachel: stand up midnight->06:00 UTC shadow rota and confirm engineers (please include pager contact list).
- Liam: please confirm the incident bridge details (dial-in + who owns the bridge).
- Monica: create the DocuSign template and route to Procurement once Liam confirms bridge.

We will treat this as a temporary operational variance (2025-06-09 through 2025-06-30) unless both parties agree to shorten/extend.

Accepting on behalf of Redwood: Monica Patel, on behalf of SRE Operations. Proceeding to provision tonight's dry-run.

Regards,
Monica
Monica Patel
SRE Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
